Subject: Physics

Question:
A silver rod of length 1 m (or 100 cm) at 0^(o)C is heated to 100^(o)C. It’s length is increased by 0.19 cm. Find the coefficient of cubical expansion of silver.
(A) 5.7 x 10^(-5)/^(o)C
(B) 0.63 x 10^(-5)/^(o)C
(C) 1.9 x 10^(-5)/^(o)C
(D) 16.1 x 10^(-5)/^(o)C
